description:
Atlin puts real homes for rent on a map.

Search a city. Every pin is a price. Tap one and you get photos, bedrooms, bathrooms, size and the address, then a link to the original listing.

• Real listings, pulled live. No sample homes, no filler
• Prices on the map, so you see a neighbourhood at a glance
• Save the homes worth a second look. They stay on your device
• No account, no ads, no tracking

Coverage depends on the listing feeds and is strongest in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom. Where Atlin has no listings for a place, it says so.

Atlin is a listing browser, not a broker. To contact a landlord or agent, open the original listing from the home's page.
promotionalText: Real rentals on a map. Search a city, read every price at a glance, save the ones worth a second look.
